verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה מָ֭לָךְ תָּגֵ֣ל הָאָ֑רֶץ יִ֝שְׂמְח֗וּ אִיִּ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh mā·lāḵ tā·ḡêl hā·’ā·reṣ yiś·mə·ḥū ’î·yîm rab·bîm
verses.literal: The LORD reigns let the earth rejoice let the distant shores be glad
verses.literalPt: Jeová é Rei; regozije-se a terra; alegrem-se as numerosas ilhas.

verses.original: עָנָ֣ן וַעֲרָפֶ֣ל סְבִיבָ֑יו צֶ֥דֶק וּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט מְכ֣וֹן כִּסְאֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·nān wa·‘ă·rā·p̄el sə·ḇî·ḇāw ṣe·ḏeq ū·miš·pāṭ mə·ḵō·wn kis·’ōw
verses.literal: Clouds and darkness surround Him righteousness and justice are His throne’s foundation
verses.literalPt: Nuvens e escuridão estão ao redor dele, justiça e juízo são a base do seu trono.

verses.original: אֵ֭שׁ לְפָנָ֣יו תֵּלֵ֑ךְ וּתְלַהֵ֖ט סָבִ֣יב צָרָֽיו׃
verses.literal: Fire goes before Him and consumes His foes on every side
verses.literalPt: Um fogo vai adiante dele e abrasa ao redor os seus adversários.

verses.original: הֵאִ֣ירוּ בְרָקָ֣יו תֵּבֵ֑ל רָאֲתָ֖ה וַתָּחֵ֣ל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: hê·’î·rū ḇə·rā·qāw tê·ḇêl rā·’ă·ṯāh wat·tā·ḥêl hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: His lightning illuminates the world the earth sees and trembles
verses.literalPt: Os seus relâmpagos alumiaram o mundo; a terra viu e tremeu.

verses.original: הָרִ֗ים כַּדּוֹנַ֗ג נָ֭מַסּוּ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מִ֝לִּפְנֵ֗י אֲד֣וֹן כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·rîm kad·dō·w·naḡ nā·mas·sū mil·lip̄·nê Yah·weh mil·lip̄·nê ’ă·ḏō·wn kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD before the Lord of all the earth
verses.literalPt: Os montes, como cera, se derreteram na presença de Jeová, na presença do Senhor de toda a terra.

verses.original: הִגִּ֣ידוּ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם צִדְק֑וֹ וְרָא֖וּ כָל־ הָעַמִּ֣ים כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hig·gî·ḏū haš·šā·ma·yim ṣiḏ·qōw wə·rā·’ū ḵāl hā·‘am·mîm kə·ḇō·w·ḏōw
verses.literal: The heavens proclaim His righteousness all the peoples see His glory
verses.literalPt: Os céus anunciam a sua justiça, e todos os povos veem a sua glória.

verses.original: יֵבֹ֤שׁוּ׀ כָּל־ עֹ֬בְדֵי פֶ֗סֶל הַמִּֽתְהַלְלִ֥ים בָּאֱלִילִ֑ים הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ־ ל֝וֹ כָּל־ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: yê·ḇō·šū kāl- ‘ō·ḇə·ḏê p̄e·sel ham·miṯ·hal·lîm bā·’ĕ·lî·lîm hiš·ta·ḥă·wū- lōw kāl- ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: All worshipers of images are put to shame those who boast in idols Worship Him all you gods
verses.literalPt: Sejam envergonhados todos os que servem a imagens de escultura, que se gloriam de ídolos. Todos os deuses prostrem-se diante dele.

verses.original: שָׁמְעָ֬ה וַתִּשְׂמַ֨ח׀ צִיּ֗וֹן וַ֭תָּגֵלְנָה בְּנ֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֑ה לְמַ֖עַן מִשְׁפָּטֶ֣יךָ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šā·mə·‘āh wat·tiś·maḥ ṣî·yō·wn wat·tā·ḡê·lə·nāh bə·nō·wṯ yə·hū·ḏāh lə·ma·‘an miš·pā·ṭe·ḵā Yah·weh
verses.literal: Zion hears and rejoices and the towns of Judah exult because of Your judgments O LORD
verses.literalPt: Sião ouviu e alegrou-se, e regozijaram-se as filhas de Judá, por causa dos teus juízos, Jeová.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה עֶלְי֥וֹן עַל־ כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ מְאֹ֥ד נַ֝עֲלֵ֗יתָ עַל־ כָּל־ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’at·tāh Yah·weh ‘el·yō·wn ‘al- kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ mə·’ōḏ na·‘ă·lê·ṯā ‘al- kāl- ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: For You O LORD are Most High over all the earth You are exalted far above all gods
verses.literalPt: Porquanto tu, Jeová, és Altíssimo sobre toda a terra, tu és sobremodo exaltado acima de todos os deuses.

verses.original: אֹהֲבֵ֥י יְהוָ֗ה שִׂנְא֫וּ רָ֥ע שֹׁ֭מֵר נַפְשׁ֣וֹת חֲסִידָ֑יו מִיַּ֥ד רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יַצִּילֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·hă·ḇê Yah·weh śin·’ū rā‘ šō·mēr nap̄·šō·wṯ ḥă·sî·ḏāw mî·yaḏ rə·šā·‘îm yaṣ·ṣî·lêm
verses.literal: Hate evil O you who love the LORD He preserves the souls of His saints He delivers them from the hand of the wicked
verses.literalPt: Vós que amais a Jeová, odiai o mal; ele preserva as almas dos seus santos, ele os livra das mão dos perversos.

verses.original: א֭וֹר זָרֻ֣עַ לַצַּדִּ֑יק וּֽלְיִשְׁרֵי־ לֵ֥ב שִׂמְחָֽה׃
verses.literal: Light shines on the righteous gladness on the upright in heart
verses.literalPt: A luz semeia-se para o justo, e a alegria, para os retos de coração.

verses.original: שִׂמְח֣וּ צַ֭דִּיקִים בַּֽיהוָ֑ה וְ֝הוֹד֗וּ לְזֵ֣כֶר קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: śim·ḥū ṣad·dî·qîm Yah·weh wə·hō·w·ḏū lə·zê·ḵer qā·ḏə·šōw
verses.literal: Rejoice in the LORD you righteous ones and praise His holy name
verses.literalPt: Alegrai-vos, ó justos, em Jeová; e rendei graças ao seu santo nome.
